# The Wine Goat

> The Wine Goat (thewinegoat.com) is an independent exam-preparation app and website for the WSET wine and spirits qualifications: Wine Levels 1, 2 and 3 and Spirits Levels 1 and 2 are available; Spirits Level 3 and the Diploma are in preparation. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by the Wine & Spirit Education Trust; WSET® is mentioned only to identify the exams.

Key facts (kept in line with https://thewinegoat.com/about/):
- Levels: Wine Level 1 (completely free), Wine Level 2 (about 1,070 practice questions), Wine Level 3 (2,000+ multiple-choice questions, 101 short written-answer questions with model answers and marking points, blind-tasting trainer for the systematic approach to tasting), Spirits Level 1 (free, about 210 questions), Spirits Level 2 (about 1,000 questions). Spirits Level 3 and the Diploma: in preparation, not yet available.
- Tools: lessons by chapter, multiple-choice practice questions with explanations (why the right answer is right and the others wrong), flashcards with spaced repetition, mock exams in the real format and timing, short-answer marking, tasting trainer, 42 interactive wine maps (atlas + map game with 1,053 places and three difficulty levels), narrated animated films, podcast lessons (45 episodes per language for Level 3 in English, French and Italian), study planner, label scanner with tasting diary, short games, a level test (20-question quick challenge, 50-question level session, 3 written questions).
- Study plan: the learner sets level, exam date, target grade (Pass, Merit, Distinction) and minutes per day; the app builds a day-by-day plan and brings back weak points.
- Languages: app interface in 14 languages; full study content in Italian, French, English and Spanish (including Argentine Spanish). Website guides in 19 language versions.
- Runs in the web browser on phone, tablet and computer. Every level has a free starting point.
- Exam formats reproduced: Level 1 (wine or spirits) 30 multiple-choice questions in 45 minutes, 70% to pass; Level 2: 50 questions in 60 minutes, 55% pass, 70% Merit, 85% Distinction; Wine Level 3 theory: 50 multiple-choice + 4 short written-answer questions, plus a blind tasting of 2 wines; 55% needed in each part.
- Practice questions are original, written by The Wine Goat to match the style of the exams; they are not official or past exam questions. No pass rates, ratings or user numbers are published.
- Contact: hello@thewinegoat.com · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/the.winegoat/

## WSET Level 1 and Level 2 (in the app: Level 1 completely free)
- WSET Level 1 Award in Wines: 30 multiple-choice questions in 45 minutes, 70% to pass, about 6 hours of guided learning, no prerequisites.
- WSET Level 2 Award in Wines: 50 multiple-choice questions in 60 minutes, 55% to pass, about 28 hours of study (16 guided), 8 principal + 22 regional grape varieties, 70+ geographical indications.
- [WSET Level 1 guide](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-level-1/) · [Livello 1](https://thewinegoat.com/it/wset-livello-1/) · [Niveau 1](https://thewinegoat.com/fr/wset-niveau-1/) · [Nivel 1](https://thewinegoat.com/es/wset-nivel-1/)
- [WSET Level 2 guide](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-level-2/) · [Livello 2](https://thewinegoat.com/it/wset-livello-2/) · [Niveau 2](https://thewinegoat.com/fr/wset-niveau-2/) · [Nivel 2](https://thewinegoat.com/es/wset-nivel-2/)

- [The grape varieties to know for WSET Level 3](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-level-3-grape-varieties/): The grape varieties you must know for WSET Level 3: where each one grows, the wine styles it makes and how to link grape, climate and winemaking in your exam answers. Free quiz included.
- [WSET Level 2 or Level 3: what really changes](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-level-2-vs-level-3/): WSET Level 2 or Level 3? The real differences in syllabus, exam format, tasting and study time, how big the jump is, and how to decide which course is right for you.

Test yourself before the exam.

- [The WSET Diploma (Level 4), explained](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-diploma-level-4/): The WSET Level 4 Diploma in Wines explained: the six units D1–D6, the 500 hours of study, how the exams work, how hard it is and how to build the Level 3 foundations you need.

## Full text
- [All guides, full text](https://thewinegoat.com/llms-full.txt): every WSET guide of the site in plain text, in 4 languages.

## WSET preparation tools and hubs
- [WSET exam preparation: choose your level and study with a method](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-exam-preparation/): Prepare for your WSET wine or spirits exam: choose the right level, follow a proven study method and train with lessons, questions, flashcards and mock exams.
- [WSET wine exam preparation: Levels 1, 2 and 3 compared](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-wine/): WSET Wine Levels 1, 2 and 3 compared: exam format, pass marks, syllabus and study hours, which level to choose and how to prepare for each one step by step.
- [WSET mock exams: how to practise the real exam before the day](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-mock-exams/): How to use WSET mock exams: the format of each level, how to sit a mock in real conditions, how to review your score and the mistakes that cost you marks.
- [WSET practice questions online, with answers and explanations](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-practice-questions/): WSET practice questions with answers for Wine Levels 1, 2, 3 and Spirits: how to use them, MCQ technique and 12 sample questions with explanations.
- [WSET Flashcards: Learn Wine & Spirits for Good](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-flashcards/): WSET flashcards with spaced repetition: what to put on each card (grapes, regions, label terms, numbers), sample cards and a 15-minute daily routine.
- [Plan Your WSET Exam Preparation, Week by Week](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-study-planner/): Build a WSET study plan from your exam date: weekly templates for Levels 1, 2 and 3, a realistic daily goal, revision phases and the final two weeks.
- [How The Wine Goat Helps You Study for WSET](https://thewinegoat.com/how-it-works/): How The Wine Goat works: choose your level, exam date and goal, follow a daily plan of lessons, questions and flashcards, fix mistakes and take mock exams.
- [WSET Preparation: Frequently Asked Questions](https://thewinegoat.com/faq/): Answers to common WSET preparation questions: which level to choose, exam formats, study time, tasting practice, and how The Wine Goat app works.
Also available in: Italiano, Français, Español, Español (AR), Deutsch, Nederlands, Polski, Português, Português (BR), Русский, Ελληνικά, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文, العربية, ไทย, Türkçe (same paths under /<lang>/, see hreflang).

## WSET Spirits guides (Levels 1, 2, 3)
- [WSET Spirits courses explained: Levels 1, 2 and 3 compared](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-spirits/): WSET spirits levels explained: exam format, pass marks, study time and who each course suits, plus how to choose between Level 1, 2 and 3 and prepare well.
- [WSET Level 1 Award in Spirits: the complete guide](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-spirits-level-1/): WSET Level 1 Spirits guide: 30 questions, 45 minutes, 70% pass. What the syllabus covers, how the exam is split, tasting basics and a one-week study plan.
- [WSET Level 2 Award in Spirits: the complete guide](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-spirits-level-2/): WSET Level 2 Spirits guide: 50 questions in 60 minutes, 55% pass, merit 70%, distinction 85%. Syllabus by area, question split, cocktails and a study plan.
- [WSET Level 3 Award in Spirits: the complete guide](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-spirits-level-3/): WSET Level 3 Spirits guide: 50 MCQ and 10 short answers in 2 h 10, two blind spirits in 30 minutes, grading rules, 'explain' questions and a study plan.
- [WSET Spirits Practice Questions (with Answers and Explanations)](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-spirits-practice-questions/): 20 free WSET Spirits practice questions for Levels 1, 2 and 3, each with the correct answer and a clear explanation, plus exam tips and common traps.
- [How Spirits Are Made: From Raw Material to Bottle (Pot Still vs Column Still)](https://thewinegoat.com/how-spirits-are-made-pot-still-column-still/): How spirits are made, step by step: raw material, fermentation, distillation and ageing. Pot still vs column still compared, with heads, hearts and tails.
- [Types of Spirits: The Complete Cheat Sheet](https://thewinegoat.com/spirits-categories-cheat-sheet/): Types of spirits explained on one page: brandy, whisky, rum, Tequila, Mezcal, vodka, gin, liqueurs and vermouth. Raw materials, key rules and label terms.
- [Classic Cocktail Families: Balance, Specs and Bar Basics](https://thewinegoat.com/classic-cocktail-families/): Learn the classic cocktail families: spirit-forward drinks, short sours, highballs and long sours. Balance rules, cocktail specs tables, tools and glassware.
Also available in: Italiano, Français, Español, Español (AR), Deutsch, Nederlands, Polski, Português, Português (BR), Русский, Ελληνικά, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文, العربية, ไทย, Türkçe (same paths under /<lang>/, see hreflang).

## About The Wine Goat and feature pages

Also in: [Italiano](https://thewinegoat.com/it/chi-siamo/), [Français](https://thewinegoat.com/fr/a-propos/), [Español](https://thewinegoat.com/es/sobre-nosotros/), [Español (AR)](https://thewinegoat.com/es-ar/sobre-nosotros/)
- [Interactive Wine Maps for WSET Study](https://thewinegoat.com/wine-maps/): 42 interactive wine maps and 1,053 places to learn: explore regions in the atlas, then find them in a map game with three levels. Built for WSET wine study. Also in: [Italiano](https://thewinegoat.com/it/mappe-del-vino/), [Français](https://thewinegoat.com/fr/cartes-des-vins/), [Español](https://thewinegoat.com/es/mapas-del-vino/), [Español (AR)](https://thewinegoat.com/es-ar/mapas-del-vino/)
- [Wine Knowledge Test: How Ready Are You for Your WSET Exam?](https://thewinegoat.com/wine-level-test/): Take a 20-question wine knowledge test, a 50-question level session or 3 written questions. See your level, weak topics and how many study days you need. Also in: [Italiano](https://thewinegoat.com/it/test-livello-vino/), [Français](https://thewinegoat.com/fr/test-niveau-vin/), [Español](https://thewinegoat.com/es/test-nivel-vino/), [Español (AR)](https://thewinegoat.com/es-ar/test-nivel-vino/)
